name: wakeshift
description: Lets Wakeshift messages wake your Claude Code sessions, even while they're idle, for the apps you connect. Its hooks run Wakeshift's connector, ~/.wakeshift/bin/wakeshift, which the plugin downloads once from Wakeshift's GitHub releases and checks against the SHA-256 it carries; the connector talks only to Wakeshift (app.wakeshift.ai), and only for conversations a Wakeshift app's tool connected. Disable or uninstall the plugin to turn it off.
